Theme

Computing & programming

enter verb

type in or record data

also type in, key in, input, enter a password, enter in a record, input and output

classical

Cic. Rosc. Com. 4: nōmen in tabulās, in cōdicem (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 261: in computātrum referre, enter (on a computer)

referō, referre, rettulī, relātum

verb · Conjugation on Wiktionary

enter, record (in accounts or a register; on a computer)

Classically to enter in the accounts or a register (in tabulās referre); Traupman keeps the verb for the computer.

Other words

  • datōrum initus — input (computer)

    also used · modern · Traupman 333

Examples

  • in ōrdinātrum referre

    to enter (on a computer)Traupman 310

  • datōrum initus exitusque

    input and outputTraupman 333

See also enter, keyboard, computer.
